# About {.page-title}

I'm an M.S. candidate in Psychology: Data Science in Human Behavior at UW–Madison (expected Dec 2026), with a B.S. in Psychology (neuroscience concentration, sociology minor) from UW–Parkside.

I build AI systems from start to finish: multi-agent document pipelines, transformer fine-tuning and calibration, LLM evaluation, computer vision classification, and behavioral prediction models. Before graduate school I spent five years in high-volume logistics and operations, working on quality assurance, documentation, and process improvement. That background is why I care about error rates, reproducibility, and cost as much as accuracy.

## Interests

- **Document AI:** reading, sorting, and extracting information from real-world paperwork. See the [document-intelligence projects](projects/index.qmd).
- **Evaluation and calibration:** held-out testing, confidence that means something, and honest error analysis.
- **Simulation and graphics:** physics-based, interactive software in the browser. See [Wave Laboratory](projects/wave-laboratory.qmd).
- **Behavior and cognition:** what predicts how people act, and where models of people go wrong.

## Technical Skills

::: {.skills}
**Languages & Data**
: Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face, PyArrow), R, MATLAB, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Parquet, Hive

**Machine Learning**
: Transformer fine-tuning, neural networks, regularized models (Lasso/Ridge), ensemble methods (random forests, bagging), resampling, model evaluation & calibration, cross-validation, SHAP feature importance, error analysis, computer vision

**AI Engineering**
: LangGraph (LangChain), multi-agent pipelines, LLM eval harnesses (including bias and robustness evals), prompt engineering, model serving (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter), ONNX + FastAPI deployment on Modal

**Engineering & Cloud**
: Git, Docker, gRPC, Apache Spark/PySpark, HDFS, bash, pytest, Quarto, CHTC (high-throughput computing), AWS, Azure, GCP
:::
